about: Golden slices for Print Lab Slicer, independent of the upstream version: each case slices a box for a printer with the job defaults (0.4 nozzle, 0.20 mm, PLA, 15 % infill, no supports) through app/src/lib/server/slicer/golden.test.ts. Layers must match exactly; seconds and grams within tolerance. null means not recorded yet: run the test with GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 GOLDEN_REASON='why' on a working engine build, review the diff and commit it.
reasons: 2026-09-27 v02.08.02.61: first engine build (linux-x64): layers and nozzle diameters recorded; seconds and grams stay null because the engine's time and weight estimates are not yet repeatable (see slicer/UPSTREAM.md, State of the engine)
